summary: Accept Core's negotiated capability report so Controller appliance adoption can finish.

guide.reason: Deployment troubleshooting now explains how to inspect a stale host report and retry the original saved operation after compatible updates.

api.reason: Authenticated POST /api/v1/agent/report accepts up to 64 capability names instead of 32; host mTLS, sequence, bounded names, errors for over-limit reports and result/retry semantics are unchanged. Controller must be updated before a Core sends more than 32 names.

roadmap.reason: The existing appliance deployment path is repaired without changing a milestone or acceptance status.

state.reason: The report limit changes admission of host observations; Core remains their source and no new durable setting is added.

verification.method: The new report regression failed before and passed after the fix; the handoff test timed out before and passed after. Controller package tests passed. No updated build was deployed to the affected host.
